review.rationale: The standing directive TITMAS-CS-STANDING-001 is applicable and referenced. The Recommendation/review chain is exact: recommendation v0.2 with its SHA256, the Qwen review v0.2 with its SHA256, and the remote-verified commit are all present and consistent. The prior no-output failure (v0.1) is preserved via prior_review_failure_reference and prior_review_failure_preserved=true. Option A uses the existing exact SOURCE_REVISION input (c1d8931930fbae15f96ee6a6ac050b081538c919) without any source change (source_code_change_authorized=false, source_code_change=false). The one-attempt execution sequence (M01–M13) is sufficient and bounded by strict caps (1 fetch, 1 worktree, 1 npm ci, 1 release, 1 test, 1 archive, 1 commit/push) with zero retries or fallbacks. All history is preserved (history_preserved=true, current_candidate_preserved=true, overwrite_authorized=false, current_candidate_overwrite=false). No deployment, release, or authority inference is created (deployment=false, release=false, authority_created=false, permission_created=false, deployment_admission_created=false, server/public site actions all zero). Stop conditions comprehensively guard against drift, schema failures, and unauthorized actions.
